$comment: Advisories judged unreachable, read by .github/scripts/dep-audit.mjs. One entry per advisory and folder; every entry needs a reason. Anything not listed here fails CI. Remove an entry the day the dependency is fixed (the audit prints a warning when an entry is no longer reported). Decision: BCWEB/guides/SECURITY_SUMMARY_EN.md section 9, 'No dependency audit in CI'.

ignore.reason: XSS sanitizer bypass in DOM.sanitize(), which maplibre applies to attribution HTML and popup content only. Both maps feed it string literals (apps/web/src/pages/admin.jsx attribution constant with attributionControl:false; telemetry-dashboard MapPage.tsx two literal attributions), neither uses Popup/setHTML/innerHTML, markers are built from numbers, and both surfaces are admin-only. The fix is a semver-major bump (5.x -> 6.10), scheduled separately.

Marvin timing attack on RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption. rsa is in Cargo.lock only through sqlx-mysql; the server enables sqlx's postgres feature alone, so rsa is never compiled (`cargo tree -i rsa --target all -e all` prints nothing). No fixed version exists upstream.
